en.headline: Hong Kong airport launches single check-in for Hangzhou and Wuhan flights
en.dek: Passengers from the two mainland cities can now check baggage through to overseas destinations via Hong Kong even when changing airlines.
body: Hong Kong International Airport on Tuesday launched a single check-in service for travellers departing Hangzhou Xiaoshan or Wuhan Tianhe airports and connecting through Hong Kong to overseas destinations. Under the arrangement, baggage is checked through to the final destination without the need to re-claim and re-check it in Hong Kong, even when the onward flight is on a different airline.

Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said the service embeds Hong Kong more directly into the national aviation network. The initial phase covers the two cities under the brands Hang Kong Tong Tianxia and E Gang Tong Tianxia, with plans to expand later.

The government said the arrangement allows passengers one-stop check-in and seamless baggage transfer, strengthening Hong Kong's role as an international aviation hub. Reciprocal arrangements will also apply for overseas passengers connecting to the mainland cities via Hong Kong.
Chan described the scheme as a policy breakthrough that goes beyond commercial expansion, enabling Hong Kong airlines and their mainland counterparts to create synergies through coordinated capacity.

zh.headline: 香港機場啟動杭州武漢聯動一張機票行李直掛服務
zh.dek: 由杭州或武漢出發經香港飛往海外的旅客，即使轉乘不同航空公司，亦可一次辦理登機手續，行李直掛目的地。
body: 香港國際機場周二啟動與杭州蕭山及武漢天河機場的通程中轉便利化服務。由這兩個內地城市出發、經香港轉飛海外目的地的旅客，即使下一程轉乘不同航空公司，亦可一次辦理登機手續，行李由起點直掛至最終目的地，無需在香港再領取及重新寄艙。
運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，有關服務把香港更直接融入國家航空網絡。首階段以「杭港通天下」及「鄂港通天下」兩個品牌推出，日後會進一步擴展。
政府指，安排讓旅客享受一張機票、一次check-in、行李直掛的服務，強化香港作為國際航空樞紐的角色。海外旅客經香港前往這兩個內地城市亦可享用相互安排。
陳美寶形容這是政策突破，不僅是商業擴展，而是讓本港與內地航空公司透過運力協同產生效益。
